name: status
description: Lifecycle status string (e.g. 'draft', 'published', 'deprecated'). Also used as the badge label.

name: statusColorMap
description: Optional override map from status value to Badge variant ('default' | 'secondary' | 'destructive' | 'outline'). Merged on top of the built-in defaults; unknown statuses fall back to 'outline'.

name: className
description: Additional classes forwarded to the underlying Badge.
